lines.text: The clock strikes four, and Clara is still holding her note. She has pressed only once.

Now, at the piano. Press one key and hold it while you count four slow beats. Did the sound last?
And here is how it ended.
Semibreve means “half a breve”, and breve means short. The breve used to be a short note.
Like the minim, it grew longer over the years. Today the breve is so long that you hardly ever see it.
One more thing to try. Play a semibreve on C and count 1 2 3 4. Imagine a note twice as long: that is a breve.
On Thursday there would be the music evening. Clara had her piece ready. Nobody had told her how loud to play it.
